data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Write failing bash tests in `tests/scripts/test-pre-commit-review-gate-arbiter.sh` covering the new arbiter-rulings.json read path in pre-commit-review-gate.sh.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD8: pre-commit hook reads arbiter-rulings.json + blocks on BLOCK ruling for current HEAD commit_sha.

## Specific failing test cases (bash test functions)

1. `test_arbiter_block_for_current_sha_blocks_commit` — pre-seed `<artifacts_dir>/arbiter-rulings.json` with `{schema_version:'1.0.0', commit_sha:<HEAD>, rulings:[{ruling:'BLOCK', rationale:'critical bug'}], summary:{block_count:1}}`. Also pre-seed valid review-status (so the existing path passes). Run pre-commit-review-gate.sh; assert exit 1 AND stderr contains 'critical bug' (the BLOCK rationale).
2. `test_arbiter_drop_only_does_not_block` — pre-seed arbiter-rulings.json with only DROP/DEFER rulings (block_count:0); run gate; assert exit 0.
3. `test_arbiter_block_for_different_sha_ignored` — pre-seed arbiter-rulings.json with `commit_sha='old-sha-abc'` (not HEAD); even with BLOCK ruling; assert exit 0 (sidecar from prior commit ignored).
4. `test_no_arbiter_sidecar_preserves_existing_behavior` — no arbiter-rulings.json present; assert existing behavior preserved (passes if review-status valid).
5. `test_corrupt_arbiter_sidecar_fails_closed_with_warning` — write malformed JSON to arbiter-rulings.json; assert exit 1 (fail-closed) with stderr WARNING about parse failure.

## Test framework
Use the project's existing bash test harness pattern (`tests/scripts/test-*.sh`). Each test sets up `WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR` to a fresh `mktemp -d`, writes fixture files, invokes `bash plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-review-gate.sh` directly, asserts exit code + stderr substrings.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 5 test functions defined in test-pre-commit-review-gate-arbiter.sh
  Verify: grep -E '^(test_|run_test).*arbiter' tests/scripts/test-pre-commit-review-gate-arbiter.sh | wc -l   # expect ≥ 5
- [ ] Test file is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-pre-commit-review-gate-arbiter.sh
- [ ] All 5 tests fail (gate has no arbiter-rulings.json read yet)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-pre-commit-review-gate-arbiter.sh 2>&1 | grep -E '(FAIL|✗)' | wc -l   # expect ≥ 5
- [ ] Test is registered in .test-index
  Verify: grep 'test-pre-commit-review-gate-arbiter.sh' .test-index

## File Impact
- tests/scripts/test-pre-commit-review-gate-arbiter.sh (new, ~220 lines)
- .test-index (append registration line)
